title: skills: objectstack-i18n lists the object translation sub-keys but not `_milestones.<field>.<value>.summary` once PR #37582 lands
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA

Filing gate: ① · Source: fleet (the `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` line of the #37524 claim; PR #37582 adds the key)

## What happens

PR #37582 (Fixes #37524) adds a translation slot to object translation bundles: `objects.<object>._milestones.<field>.<value>.summary`. When a timeline shows a fired milestone, its row is re-composed at read time in the reader's language, and picklist values in it show as that language's option labels.

`skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` teaches the object sub-keys in its table under "All translatable content for a single object is aggregated under `objects.{object_name}`" (`label`, `fields`, `_views`, `_actions`, `_sections`, `_tabs`, `_relatedLists`, `_validations`, `_actions….refusals`). Once #37582 merges, that table has no `_milestones` row. An agent that writes an app's translations from the skill leaves every milestone summary English, and the timeline mixes languages.

`skills/**` is governed (Tier H), so this text does not ride the code PR.

## Expected

- One row in that table: `_milestones.{field}.{value}` → `summary`, the sentence a fired milestone writes to the timeline for that field and value. Say that the stored row is unchanged, that the reader's language is applied at read time, and that a field the reader cannot see keeps its sentence hidden in every language (as #37582 implements it).
- Pay for the row in the same file under the token ratchet (no ceiling moves).
- Write it against the merged #37582 tree: key spelling, the `{value}` form, and what the resolver substitutes.

Blocked-by: #37582 (merge)
Category ①: a shipped skill would teach an incomplete key list for a slot the platform reads, so an app built from it leaves a visible string untranslated.
Priority: p2, the grade of #37524 (a non-English timeline row shows English; it doesn't block a workflow and isn't wrong data).
Business reason: non-English readers of a timeline that an app's milestones write see their own language only if the app's translation bundle carries the slot, and agents author those bundles from this skill.
Reader: seat 2 area s2-ux-T (repo:objectstack#2), after #37582 merges; Tier H, so os-zhuang approves.
Dedupe: `objectstack-i18n _milestones` (open issues) 1 hit, #37524 itself (the code card). No skills card exists.
Related: #37524, PR #37582.
